name: Michelle Delves
bio:
Hi there! My name’s Michelle, and I’m a bilingual Eurasian Data, Analytics & AI Engineer at Air New Zealand with a background in Engineering Science (BEng Hons).


I really enjoy digging into the nitty-gritty of physical and operational systems, connecting them with the data they generate, and turning that understanding into trusted digital solutions with the bigger picture and long-term impact in mind. Naturally curious and creative, I approach problems with a systems-thinking mindset, challenging assumptions and drawing on a global perspective shaped by growing up overseas and across cultures.


Outside of work, I’m an avid musician. I’ve studied piano, violin and voice, taught music since 2020, and sung with one of New Zealand’s national choirs. I’m also passionate about equity and inclusion, particularly supporting women in STEM and creating opportunities for others to thrive.
